# Shipping and delivery

## Delivery times
Orders placed on working days before 14:00 CET are dispatched the same day, all other orders the next working day.
Standard delivery takes 2-3 working days to Germany and the Netherlands, 3-5 working days to Austria, Belgium and Luxembourg, and 4-7 working days to the rest of the EU.
We currently ship only within the European Union. We do not ship to the UK, Switzerland, Norway or overseas.

## Shipping costs
Shipping to Germany and the Netherlands costs EUR 4.90. Shipping to other EU countries costs EUR 7.90.
Shipping is free for orders over EUR 60 to Germany and the Netherlands and over EUR 90 to other EU countries.

## Carriers
We ship with DHL in Germany and Austria and with PostNL in the Netherlands and Belgium. Other countries are served by DPD.
Express delivery and delivery to parcel lockers (Packstation) are not available.
